/** A member who owes at least this many cents may not borrow until they pay. */
export const BLOCKING_BALANCE_CENTS = 1000;

/** Returns what a member owes, in cents: the sum of their unpaid fees. */
export function outstandingBalance(store, memberId) {
  return store
    .listFees(memberId)
    .filter((fee) => !fee.paid)
    .reduce((sum, fee) => sum + fee.amountCents, 0);
}
import { daysBetween } from '../helpers/dates.js';
import { DAILY_LATE_FEE_CENTS, GRACE_DAYS } from './schedule.js';

/** Returns the late fee in cents for a loan returned on `returnedOn`, 0 when none is due. */
export function assessLateFee({ loan, item, member, returnedOn }) {
  if (member.type === 'staff' || member.type === 'junior') return 0;
  const daysLate = daysBetween(loan.dueOn, returnedOn);
  if (daysLate <= GRACE_DAYS) return 0;
  return daysLate * DAILY_LATE_FEE_CENTS[item.format];
}
/** Records that a member paid a fee in full at the desk, and returns the paid fee. */
export function payFee(store, feeId, paidOn) {
  const fee = store.getFee(feeId);
  if (fee === undefined) throw new Error(`Unknown fee ${feeId}`);
  if (fee.paid) throw new Error(`Fee ${feeId} is already paid`);
  return store.saveFee({ ...fee, paid: true, paidOn });
}
/** What a day late costs, in cents, by format. */
export const DAILY_LATE_FEE_CENTS = { book: 25, dvd: 100, magazine: 10, laptop: 500 };

/** An item returned at most this many days after its due date costs nothing. */
export const GRACE_DAYS = 1;
/** The reasons a librarian may waive a fee for. */
export const WAIVER_REASONS = ['returned-in-book-drop', 'staff-error', 'hardship'];

/** Waives a fee for one of the allowed reasons, and returns the waived fee. */
export function waiveFee(store, feeId, reason) {
  if (!WAIVER_REASONS.includes(reason)) throw new Error(`Unknown waiver reason ${reason}`);
  const fee = store.getFee(feeId);
  if (fee === undefined) throw new Error(`Unknown fee ${feeId}`);
  return store.saveFee({ ...fee, waivedReason: reason });
}

A late fee can no longer be more than the item's replacement cost. All 62 tests pass: the 61 existing ones and one new test.

The change is in `assessLateFee` in `lib/fees/overdue-charges.js`. It now returns the smaller of the usual fee (days late × daily rate) and the item's `replacementCostCents`. The cap applies to every format and to the fee `returnItem` charges, because that is the only caller.

The new test in `test/fees.test.js` covers your case. A laptop returned 92 days late would have cost 46,000 cents. It is now charged the 32,000-cent replacement cost.

The existing fee tests stay under their items' replacement costs, so the cap never changes them. I didn't record the reason for this change in Kronomind.
